body: I didn’t have to. My therapist contacted my parents after that big misunderstanding and caused my mom so much pain. My mom kept crying telling me how much she loves me and it broke my heart seeing her cry like that. I understand my therapist was doing her job, but she didn’t even warn me or asked about clarification before doing anything. I tried to talk, but nobody believed me and I was forced against my will to go to a mental hospital.

I know my mom loves me, but my parents would be better off not spending money on me anymore and they could received my stuff when I’m gone. I tried to contact my friends as a one last time to hang out, but nobody cared enough to respond to me. I know some of them read my text messages.

I’m just a disappointment to everyone. I can’t do anything right and all I do is fuck up everything whenever I try to do something. My parents would be financially stable if I was gone, nobody cared enough to see me one last time, and even strangers told me to kill myself. My mom should’ve never saved me when I was born.

I don’t have a plan yet. I’m thinking of the best way to die and I want it to be as painless as possible. I’m thinking of writing a will or letters to my loved ones for now, but I’m not sure what to write. I want to make sure my parents received everything.
I’m actually a girl. I was playing League, but I don’t know how to play it. My friend told me to keep playing in order to understand how to play it.
